title: 2 Eggs and 5 Potatoes! I Stopped Ordering Pizza After Making This

segments.description: Wide establishing shot of a kitchen counter displaying fresh potatoes, eggs, cheese, and mixing bowls [[00:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPqSQxiX8fA&t=2)].
Medium close-up shot of raw potatoes being peeled and grated into fine shreds on a metal box grater [[00:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPqSQxiX8fA&t=50)].
Close-up action shot of excess moisture being squeezed out of the grated potatoes using a clean cloth [[01:52](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPqSQxiX8fA&t=112)].
Medium shot of fresh eggs being cracked and beaten into a bowl before mixing with the seasoned potatoes [[02:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPqSQxiX8fA&t=160)].
Medium action shot of the potato and egg mixture being pressed evenly into a hot, oiled skillet to form a golden crust [[03:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPqSQxiX8fA&t=210)].
Close-up action shot of the large potato crust being flipped carefully over a plate back into the pan [[04:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPqSQxiX8fA&t=260)].
Medium close-up shot of rich tomato sauce, melted mozzarella cheese, and sliced toppings being layered over the crispy potato base [[05:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPqSQxiX8fA&t=315)].
Close-up action shot of the skillet being covered with a lid to melt the cheese until bubbly and golden [[06:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPqSQxiX8fA&t=380)].
Wide tabletop shot displaying the finished potato pizza sliced and garnished with fresh herbs [[07:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPqSQxiX8fA&t=450)].
